run_depth_inference: run depth estimation inference on images from a directory using a checkpoint model
run_depth_inference_batch: run batch depth inference on images with configurable batch size and output directory
run_depth_inference_torchscript: run depth inference using a TorchScript checkpoint model with fp32 precision
run_depth_inference_fp16: run depth inference with fp16 precision on images from a text file list
run_depth_visualization: run depth map visualization with surface normals and save results to output directory
